Individuals who can fluently read and write Spanish, Mandarin, Tagalog, or other languages beside English are strongly encouraged to apply. Experience with video editing and graphic design is also a plus. Nevada ties are a plus, but not required.

Writing a weekly newsletter, creating digital ads, and participating in other efforts to keep constituents of Nevada's Fourth District informed about the work of a busy Congressional office
